thread:
Rina: Quick check: the new Dashboard card header in compact mode loses visible focus when tabbing. Using dark theme + Safari macOS. Screenshot attached.
Diego: Repro'd. Header title and the overflow menu both have no focus ring. Feels like we removed outline globally.
Maya: Also the small metric badges (0.6rem) drop below contrast threshold on dark. a11y-bot flagged color-contrast.
a11y-bot: Scan 1772941130: failures: color-contrast (2.9:1 for .metric-badge), focus-visible (no focus for .card-header button), skip-link (no skip link to main content).
Rina: Proposed quick fixes: restore focus-visible on buttons, bump badge text to 13px and use #e9f2ff on dark, and add skip link in app shell.
Diego: For focus, prefer :focus-visible with fallback. CSS snippet: .card-header button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0b84ff; outline-offset:3px }
Maya: For badges, can we change token color to var(--text-bright) only for small sizes? That avoids a global change.
Rina: Also ensure overflow menu has aria-label and menu items have role=menuitem radio if they are exclusive.
a11y-bot: Suggestion: add role="navigation" to sidebar and aria-current to active route links.
Diego: I'll make a small PR with the CSS + aria changes. Assign RDW-7989. Can one of you smoke-test VoiceOver after?
Maya: I can run VoiceOver briefly. Also let's add a short checklist item in design docs about not removing outlines site-wide.
Rina: Thanks — small patch only. Will wait on the PR link. :thumbsup:
